hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Middle East, archipelago in the Persian Gulf, east of Saudi Arabia || mostly low desert plain rising gently to low central escarpment || close to primary Middle Eastern petroleum sources; strategic location in Persian Gulf, through which much of the Western world's petroleum must transit to reach open ocean || Resources: oil, associated and nonassociated natural gas, fish, pearls || Exports: refined petroleum, aluminum, iron ore, aluminum wire, jewelry (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly low desert plain rising gently to low central escarpment || Middle East, archipelago in the Persian Gulf, east of Saudi Arabia

climate.excerpt: arid; mild, pleasant winters; very hot, humid summers || periodic droughts; dust storms

economy.excerpt: high-income, growing Middle Eastern island economy; oil and aluminum exporter with diversification led by services, construction and manufacturing; regional finance and tourism hub; high public debt linked to oil revenue dependence and limited tax base; vulnerable to water reservoir depletion || Exports: refined petroleum, aluminum, iron ore, aluminum wire, jewelry (2023) || Industries: petroleum processing and refining, aluminum smelting, iron pelletization, fertilizers, Islamic and offshore banking, insurance, ship repairing, tourism
